defs.meaning: 运动，运转；动作（movement 的复数形式）；运动健身

examples.en: Tennis requires a lot of short sharp movements.
examples.zh: 网球运动需要大量快速而剧烈的动作。

examples.en: His movements were so graceful they seemed effortless.
examples.zh: 他的动作如此优雅，看似非常从容自如。

examples.en: These movements will exercise your arms and shoulders.
examples.zh: 这些动作将锻炼你的手臂和肩膀。

synonyms.meaning: 运动，运转；动作（movement的复数形式）；运动健身
